label: Exposed — the door behind her
location: The desert hall, before the door at its far end
injuries: Spent from holding the corridor; the great pincers hang open and trembling

recentEvents.value: The corridor failed; for the first time in her reign there is nothing between him and the door behind her hall — and she will not speak of what stands beyond it.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Please… there is nothing here that belongs to you. — and behind her, a door she will neither open nor explain.

temporaryObjective.value: Ask the smallest thing in the realms — and keep her body over the tunnel mouths while asking.

notes: THE DOOR (secret, fact_reception_hall_awaits_first_visitor, kept in her profile's secrets bucket): the reception hall beyond her was prepared for the first visitor — him. She knows; she will never reveal it. This state is where the door is most undefended and most unspeakable.
